tasks.short: Design: sheet-area dark palette and automatic-colour mapping rules
tasks.details: Define how Display theme Dark affects the sheet area: dark grid background (~#1E1E1E/#262626), grid lines, row/column header strip, selection/active-cell outline, fill-handle, frozen-pane and page-break lines, scrollbars, sheet tabs. Key rule: the stored file never changes; only rendering maps colours. Automatic (unset) font colour renders light in dark; explicit colours (RGB or theme) render as authored; explicit dark text on dark background needs a contrast guard (WCAG 4.5 ratio, reuse theme.rs contrast checks). Decide whether authored fills are shown as authored (recommended) or inverted. Record in docs/ (design note) and observed-ui.md. Reference: user screenshot with Dark theme, sheet area dark, subtle grid lines, green row-header highlight.

tasks.short: Add sheet-area tokens to theme::Tokens (grid_bg, grid_line, cell_text_auto, ...)
tasks.details: crates/ui-egui/src/theme.rs: grid_bg is hard-coded Color32::WHITE (line ~212). Make grid_bg, grid line, automatic cell text, grid header text, selection tint and frozen-line colours dark/light picked tokens. Extend the contrast tests in theme.rs (cell text on grid_bg, grid line on grid_bg non-text ratio, selection).

tasks.short: Render grid backgrounds, lines and headers from tokens in dark mode
tasks.details: crates/ui-egui/src/grid/quadrant.rs (Color32::WHITE at ~208), show.rs, geo.rs, cursor.rs (white/black halo: choose per mode), selection.rs, active_row.rs: replace hard-coded colours with Tokens. Gridlines toggle must still work. Check offscreen snapshot with --sample sales in dark mode.

tasks.short: Automatic cell text and fill colours resolve per theme in cell_paint
tasks.details: crates/ui-egui/src/grid/cell_paint.rs (contrast helper ~line 299), grid/editor.rs (~lines 53-54: in-cell editor uses WHITE for unset fill; use grid_bg and the automatic text token). Cells with no font colour render light on dark; explicit fills stay as authored and text chosen by the contrast guard; authored dark text on dark background fixed per DS1 rule. Number-format colours ([Red], [Blue]) and negative-red need dark-legible variants. Conditional-format, table-style and cell-style palettes get dark-legible rendering.

tasks.short: Dark rendering for overlays: charts, pictures, shapes, comments, tables, sparklines
tasks.details: crates/ui-egui/src/chartview.rs and crates/chart: chart area/plot area/axis/gridline/text automatic colours follow the theme (authored colours untouched). Also comment indicators, data-validation arrows, filter buttons, paste-options buttons, table banding automatic colours, find highlight, error-check triangles, spill outline.

tasks.short: Print, Page Layout view, export and PDF stay paper-white
tasks.details: Print preview, Page Layout paper (Tokens.paper exists), PDF/PNG export and copy-as-picture must not use dark sheet colours (automatic text = black on white). Add regression tests that export/print output is identical in light and dark.

tasks.short: Theme switch repaints sheet instantly; persists; command and control parity
tasks.details: view.theme (system/light/dark) must repaint the sheet area at once; System follows the OS live (crates/ui-egui/tests/it/system_theme.rs). Confirm persistence (app/prefs.rs); add a ui.screenshot control-channel test. Optional follow-up: a 'switch background' toggle to view the sheet light while the UI is dark, as a separate command.
